newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch 2007 bond raises final total of NLG 7.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Dutch 2007 bond raises final total of NLG 7.5 bln.

text.p: The Finance Ministry said tap sales of the government's new 5.75 percent bond due February 2007 had raised a final total amount of 7.5 billion guilders.
A spokesman said the final total included 800 million guilders' worth of bonds purchased by the ministry's capital markets agency which will be gradually resold in the market.
The ministry said the bonds were sold at an average price of 100.85 for an average yield of 5.64 percent.
Tap sales began on Monday when they raised 3.6 billion guilders. A further 1.1 billion guilders was raised on Tuesday and a further 2.8 billion on Wednesday.
Some debt market analysts believe the Dutch government might hold only one more bond sale in 1997, possibly reopening sales of the new 5.75 percent February 2007 bond.
A minimum amount of 10 billion guilders is generally considered necessary to achieve benchmark status.
